outOfScope: string literals, indexes, slices, and f-strings

claims.claim: Python str values are immutable sequences, and the standard library documents no mutable string type.
lower returns a copy with cased characters converted to lowercase, while strip returns a copy with leading and trailing characters removed.
find returns the lowest position of a substring in the requested slice and returns -1 when the substring is absent.
replace returns a copy with occurrences of one substring replaced by another; its optional count limits how many replacements are made.
split returns a list of words when no separator is supplied or splits on the supplied delimiter, and join concatenates strings from an iterable using the receiver as the separator.
The Python tutorial identifies the standard types page as the reference for String Methods.
